from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyReport(BaseModel):
    """Captures the financial data for a single company from a single document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="The stock/securities code of the company")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period (e.g., '2025-Q1')")
    net_profit_attributable_to_shareholders: float | None = Field(description="Net profit attributable to shareholders (can be negative)")
    operating_cash_flow_net: float | None = Field(description="Net cash flow from operating activities")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency of the financial figures, e.g., 'CNY'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Top-level class aggregating extracted company data from all documents."""
    companies: list[CompanyReport]
